summary: Two skiers from Louisville, Kentucky followed GPS directions over winter-closed Hagerman Pass (11,939 ft) toward Aspen; their vehicle became stuck in deep snow near the Carlton tunnel on the abandoned railroad grade at about 9:45 a.m. One hiked down Lake County Road 4 to reach cell coverage and call for help; four Lake County SAR personnel in two teams rescued both to incident command at the east side of Turquoise Lake Dam, uninjured. The driver was cited for disregarding traffic-control devices. Article notes it was the second such Hagerman Pass railroad-grade vehicle rescue that week.
location: Hagerman Pass railroad grade near Carlton tunnel, below Hagerman Pass
responding_agency: Lake County Search and Rescue / Lake County Sheriff's Office
